Job Summary

Job Title- Group Data Privacy (GDP) - Data Privacy Analyst, AS

Location- Bangalore, India

Role Description

  • CAFC is responsible for managing the compliance and anti-financial crime risk of Deutsche Bank Group. Our mission is to ensure that CAFC services are provided to the bank with the goals of protecting its integrity and reputation and managing legal risk to make transactions viable and safe. We partner with Risk, Regulation, Legal, Group Audit and others to provide a proactive integrated risk management approach.
  • We work closely with managers to coordinate activities across business lines so we avoid violations of laws. We make sure the Bank has up-to-date information on regulatory and legal changes and continues to be seen as a trusted, respected market participant.

Group Data Privacy (GDP)

  • Group Data Privacy (GDP) is an independent 2nd Line of Defense risk type control function within Legal which defines the risk management framework for data protection and privacy risks. GDP is located in Frankfurt, New York, London, and Berlin and Bangalore organized in a matrix structure with regional Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and Business Partners providing guidance to Business Divisions and Infrastructure Functions.
  • Moreover, GDP manages a global network of local, internal data protection officers and rolled-out a controls framework in order to safeguard Deutsche Bank s integrity and reputation and to ensure the correct processing of personal data entrusted to us. As part of the TPRM process, as a 2LoD control function, GDP is mandated to review third party outsourcing activities adherence with data privacy requirements.

Your key responsibilities

  • Advise and perform on the Data Protection Impact Assessment, in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line and the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the DPIA relevant facts, the (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures.
  • Adivse and support in the banks global AI related governance process (AI Oversight Forum), in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line, the other Risk Function in the AIOF as well the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the AI use case, support the identification of (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures in a timely manner .
  • Advise and perform the initial review of Data Breach notifications ensuring that the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO are timely involved and support them with their Data Breach assessment and documentation in order to avoid and mitigate potential data privacy risks
  • Advise and support the Service Officers of divisions and infrastructure functions on Data Protection related controls, attestations and evidences and GDP Assessment in order to meet the data protection requirements including Schrems II requirements.
  • Remain informed of regulatory developments in the data protection related outsourcing requirements including relevant GDP Policies and procedures as well as (assist if required in) maintenance of GDP Key Operating Documents
  • Prepare submission to GDP Business Partners respectively local DPO for risk acceptance / approval in line with GDP Key Operating Documents (KOD), follow up and escalation, if required.
  • Maintain GDP related documentation of transactions, respective findings and documented risks in the GDP tool.
  • Collaborate closely with GDP Business Partner and local DPOs as well as other control functions units performing privacy assessment tasks.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of the data privacy regulatory requirements applicable to DB incl. the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and remain up-to-date with relevant regulatory requirements and industry trends.
  • Maintain close collaboration with other functions within GDP such as Law Monitoring and Training Awareness.
  • Provide ad hoc support for Controls Assurance activities when required.

Your skills and experience

  • University degree, preferably in Business or Operations, law degree a plus
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations, financial industry, outsourcing or IT background a plus
  • Experience with managing deadlines and working to tight deadlines
  • Experience in making formal (written or oral) presentations and recommendations in a corporate setting
  • English proficiency (oral and written) a must. German a plus
  • Computer proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Lotus Notes required
  • Experience in SharePoint or other database tools a plus

Competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to articulate issues in plain and clear language orally (as well as in writing) which enables the audience to follow easily
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Ability to handle stress and high volumes
  • Ability to reach solutions proactively, quickly and diplomatically
  • Strategic and proactive approach to problem identification, analysis and resolution
  • Ability to work independently, with minimal to no oversight
  • Ability to work in an intercultural environment
  • Experience in personnel management are an advantage

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

You will collaborate closely with SoC and platform architects, IP and physical design teams, software and firmware engineering, silicon validation, and packaging teams to deliver breakthrough improvements in power efficiency, performance per watt, and battery life. Algorithm, Firmware Software Interface Architecture

  • Develop and architect new power algorithms and software features using state of the art techniques, including classfiers, regression models, machine learning approches for CPU/GPU power and performance optimization.
  • Define and implement software interfaces that influence and optimize hardware behavior across the SoC.

System Level Power Architecture

  • Collaborate with global architecture and design teams to implement and validate SoC power management solutions.

Hands On Engineering

  • Experience profiling software workloads on CPUs and GPUs.

  • Background in SOC hardware design, clock distribution, power delivery and performance

jobDescription:

We are looking for a Sr. Staff AI Platform Engineer to join our team. This is an On-site role based in Bangalore/Pune, reporting to the Senior Manager in the IT Data Strategy department.   • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the overall team, fostering an open feedback culture delivered with clarity and respect to build lasting trust.

jobDescription:
BASIC FUNCTION

The Junior Supply Chain Risk Analyst will assist in identifying, assessing, and managing risks associated with third parties. The junior analyst will support various departments and stakeholders in developing and implementing effective risk management strategies.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Risk Assessment Support: Assist in assessing risks including Geographical, Reputational, Cyber Security, Sanctions, Human Resources, Business Continuity, Anti-Bribery/Anti-Corruption, Artificial Intelligence, ESG, and Privacy.
  • Daily Operations: Support day-to-day responsibilities of the SCRM program, including intake and handling of requests for new third parties, gathering documentation for due diligence and onboarding tasks, and maintaining the SCRM database.
  • Monitoring: Help monitor third parties for changes in their risk profile, including mergers and acquisitions, regulatory changes, and other external factors.
  • Risk Assessment: Conduct preliminary risk assessments on new and existing third parties under supervision.
  • Database Maintenance: Ensure the integrity of the SCRM database by accurately documenting and consistently updating contact information, products, and services to maintain reliable and trustworthy data.
  • Reporting: Assist in generating standardized reports to inform business owners and management on third-party risk and performance.
  • Risk Management: Support effective risk management change initiatives.
  • Support: Provide support and expertise to business owners on third-party relationship management.
  • Incident Management: Assist in the ongoing management of escalations and incidents related to due diligence and monitoring of third parties.
  • Remediation: Help facilitate or assist in the remediation of any third-party-related findings or issues.
  • Program Improvement: Contribute to the improvement of the Supply Chain Risk Management Program.
  • Vendor Communication: Communicate with third-party vendors to address identified risks and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements.
  • Industry Trends: Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices related to Supply Chain Risk Management.
  • Special Projects: Assist with any special projects as needed.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Additional duties as directed by management.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor s degree in Information Security, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Relevant internships or up to 1 year of experience in third-party risk management or a related field.

Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, or Certifications:

  • Analytical Skills: Basic ability to evaluate data and identify potential risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Communication Skills: Proficient in effectively conveying information to various stakeholders.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Basic familiarity with regulatory requirements related to third-party risk management, such as GDPR, HIPAA, ESG, or PCI-DSS.
  • Technical Proficiency: Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite and willingness to learn risk management software.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Attention to Detail: Keen attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Teamwork and Independence: Capable of working both independently and collaboratively to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

The Partner Enablement Operations Manager is a senior operator and builder responsible for designing and running a scalable, predictable, and data-driven operating model for partner enablement at Databricks.

This role serves as the operational backbone and strategic integrator for partner enablement, connecting global strategy to the execution across AMER, EMEA, and APJ regions while ensuring programs are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale.

The ideal candidate brings strong executive presence, systems thinking, and a bias for automation. They know how to reduce operational friction, build governance that scales, and introduce AI-enabled workflows that improve responsiveness without adding unnecessary complexity or headcount.

We are looking for a builder who can architect operating systems and drive scalability and excellence for the future.

Responsibilities

  • Own the partner enablement operating model, including core planning cadences, governance mechanisms, and execution frameworks that connect strategy to execution.
  • Run QBRs, MBRs, and executive reviews for partner enablement leadership, using clear metrics and forward-looking insights to drive accountability and decision-making.
  • Lead end-to-end execution of partner enablement initiatives, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and deliverables are managed effectively across functions and regions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and operating reviews that surface partner engagement, program performance, risk signals, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Act as a key point of contact for cross-regional operational issues and escalations, resolving immediate friction while converting recurring issues into structural improvements.
  • Design and implement scalable workflows, SOPs, SLAs, and intake mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and create a better experience for internal stakeholders and partners.
  • Introduce AI-enabled and automation-first workflows for intake, reporting, support, certification, and partner operations where they can safely improve speed, quality, and scale.
  • Collaborate closely with the Partner organization, Learning and Enablement, Professional Services, and other cross-functional teams to remove friction and improve execution across the partner ecosystem.
  • Partner closely with the broader operations business to drive cross-functional leverage of ideas and excellence, ensuring new methods and operational innovations are scaled beyond just partner operations.
  • Establish clear ownership models, decision rights, and governance guardrails to support regional nuance without creating shadow processes or operational inconsistencies.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Learning Operations, Program Management, Professional Services Operations, or a related operational leadership field in a high-growth technology environment.
  • Proven experience supporting global or multi-region teams and translating central strategy into executable operating plans.
  • Preferred experience in the Data & AI space, with a strong understanding of Databricks platform capabilities, key differentiators, and end-to-end solutions, and the ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ownership of operating cadence, forecasting, planning, and execution frameworks in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn data into executive insight, operational decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience improving processes and workflows, with a clear track record of reducing manual effort and increasing scale through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions without direct authority.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities across time zones, and drive execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Must be open to working a flexible schedule, including frequent late hours to accommodate discussions with the broader enablement team and partner liaisons, the majority of whom are based in the AMER timezone.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in partner enablement, customer education, learning operations, or training operations.
  • Deep expertise working with and for System Integrators (SIs) and ISVs, with a strong grasp of their core operational principles and business models.
  • Fluency with AI tools, workflow automation, and analytics platforms used to streamline operations and generate actionable insights.
  • Strong commercial and operational acumen, including comfort with utilization, forecasting, partner spend, margin thinking, or RevOps-aligned execution.
  • Experience operating in a highly matrixed international environment with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuance.

Success Metrics

  • Operational Predictability: Build a disciplined partner enablement operating cadence where risks are surfaced early and execution is measurable and consistent.
  • Stakeholder Experience and Self-Sufficiency: Increase the percentage of standard partner enablement requests handled through structured, low-touch, or self-service workflows.
  • Escalation Management and Process Resilience: Reduce recurring operational friction by improving escalation handling, clarifying ownership, and improving systemic resolution of recurring issues.
  • Scalable Execution: Improve throughput, consistency, and delivery quality across global partner enablement programs without relying on incremental manual work.
  • AI-Enabled Transformation: Deploy practical AI-enabled workflows that improve speed, visibility, and efficiency across intake, reporting, support, and partner operations.

jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to CEO Business Development, AI & International Engagement

Location: Bangalore
Experience: 5-10 years preferred
Employment Type: Full-time
Travel: Frequent national and international travel

About the Role

We are looking for a highly articulate, confident, commercially minded and tech-savvy Executive Assistant to the CEO who can operate well beyond the traditional Executive Assistant role.

This is not an administrative or calendar-management position.

The ideal candidate will be a trusted extension of the CEO in business interactions and should possess the relationship-building ability, confidence and commercial instincts of a strong business-development professional, combined with the organization, discretion and judgment expected from an Executive Assistant.

The role involves significant interaction with customers, prospects, partners, senior executives and international business contacts, including accompanying the CEO to customer meetings, conferences, exhibitions and business events in India and overseas.

The candidate should also be AI-native, comfortable using Generative AI and modern digital tools to improve research, communication, presentations, content creation and executive productivity.

Key Responsibilities

1. CEO & Executive Office Support

  • Work closely with the CEO on business priorities, strategic initiatives and important engagements.
  • Prepare the CEO for customer meetings, conferences, presentations and business discussions.
  • Conduct research on customers, prospects, industries, competitors and events.
  • Prepare executive briefing notes, presentations, meeting summaries and business documents.
  • Track important discussions, opportunities, commitments and follow-ups.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely execution of CEO-driven initiatives.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.

2. Customer Engagement & Business Development

This is a highly relationship-oriented role.

The candidate should be comfortable acting as an extension of the CEO in customer and business-development situations.

Responsibilities include:

  • Accompanying the CEO to customer meetings and business discussions.
  • Building rapport with customers, prospects, partners and senior executives.
  • Initiating conversations and confidently networking with people not previously known to the candidate.
  • Understanding customer requirements and identifying potential business opportunities.
  • Supporting lead generation and relationship development.
  • Following up with prospects and contacts after meetings and events.
  • Maintaining professional relationships and developing a strong business network.
  • Identifying relevant opportunities, introductions, events and connections that could benefit the company.

A natural sales personality and the ability to influence and build relationships will be highly valued.

3. Conferences, Events & International Engagement

The candidate should be comfortable representing the company alongside the CEO at:

  • International and national conferences
  • Technology and AI events
  • Trade shows and exhibitions
  • Customer meetings
  • Partner meetings
  • Business networking events
  • Industry forums

You should be comfortable walking into an unfamiliar environment, introducing yourself, starting conversations, understanding people quickly and building meaningful professional relationships.

Frequent travel within India and internationally is an integral part of this position.

4. AI & Digital Technology

A strong interest and practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI is an important requirement.

The candidate should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other emerging AI platforms for:

  • Business and customer research
  • Information analysis
  • Content creation
  • Presentation development
  • Business communication
  • Executive productivity
  • Idea generation and brainstorming
  • Workflow improvement and automation

Experience with AI-powered image and video generation, video editing, presentation creation or digital-content production will be an additional advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who actively experiment with AI and continuously discover new ways to use technology to work smarter and faster.

5. Communication & Executive Presence

The candidate must have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

You should be:

  • Highly articulate and fluent in English.
  • Confident communicating with senior executives and customers.
  • An excellent conversationalist and active listener.
  • Comfortable presenting ideas and information.
  • Persuasive without being aggressive.
  • Professionally groomed and polished.
  • Comfortable in formal business environments as well as informal networking situations.
  • Capable of representing the CEO and company with maturity and professionalism.
  • Sensitive to cultural differences when dealing with international customers and partners.

6. Foreign Language Skills

Knowledge of a foreign language will be a significant advantage.

Spanish language proficiency will receive particular preference, especially conversational or professional-level Spanish.

Knowledge of Portuguese, French or other international business languages will also be considered an advantage.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Commercially minded and business-oriented
  • Confident and highly presentable
  • Smart, resourceful and highly observant
  • Strong in interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Naturally outgoing and comfortable meeting new people
  • Comfortable initiating conversations and networking
  • Able to read people and situations quickly
  • Able to think on her feet and handle unexpected situations
  • Proactive rather than dependent on instructions
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable interacting with senior executives
  • Tech-savvy and genuinely interested in AI
  • A fast learner who embraces new technologies
  • Comfortable with frequent national and international travel
  • Discreet, trustworthy and capable of handling confidential information
  • Mature enough to operate independently in high-level business environments

Most importantly:

You should be someone who makes things happen.

We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions or manages a calendar. We want someone who sees an opportunity, takes initiative, starts the conversation, builds the relationship and follows through.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be particularly relevant:

  • Executive Assistant to a CEO / Founder
  • Business Development
  • Sales
  • Client / Relationship Management
  • Corporate Communications
  • Technology / IT
  • AI / Digital Technology
  • Consulting
  • Events & Conferences
  • International Business
  • Luxury Hospitality
  • Aviation / Travel
  • PR / Media

A combination of Executive Assistant + Business Development/Sales + Technology/AI exposure would be ideal.

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a traditional Administrative Assistant or Executive Assistant role focused primarily on:

  • Calendar management
  • Appointment scheduling
  • Routine administrative work
  • Filing and documentation
  • Office administration

These responsibilities may occasionally be required, but they are not the core purpose of this position.

The core purpose is to help the CEO build relationships, develop business opportunities, represent the company, engage with customers and leverage technology to operate more effectively.

Why This Role Is Different

This position provides direct exposure to:

  • The CEO and company leadership
  • International customers and business partners
  • Global conferences and industry events
  • Business development and sales
  • Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies
  • International business environments
  • Strategic business discussions

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to develop into a high-impact business professional, rather than remain in a purely administrative career path.

The ideal candidate is:

Articulate | Commercially Smart | Confident | Presentable | Tech-Savvy | AI-Native | Persuasive | Proactive | Well-Connected | Resourceful | Internationally Mobile

If you are someone who can represent the CEO confidently, connect with people, identify opportunities, leverage AI and make things happen we would like to hear from you.

title: AI / ML Engineer
jobDescription:
As an AI/ML Engineer, you will research and select the right ML/LLM models and turn them into working integrations for our products and ourcustomers systems (SaaS, portals, e commerce, CRM/ERP, mobile apps, internal tools). You will own end to end delivery: from understanding the business problem to building workflows (e.g., n8n/Make) and deploying and maintaining AI features in production.
 
Roles Responsibilities
  • Research and evaluate ML/LLM and Vision models that can improve our internal operations and our customers business processes (SaaS, portals, e commerce, CRM/ERP, mobile apps).
  • Evaluate, develop, optimize, use and self host models needed for various jobs
  • Design and build AI integrations for CRM, ERP, inventory, and other business systems, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) based integrations where relevant.
  • Implement AI driven workflows using tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, etc., and connect them with APIs, databases, and third party services.
  • Build Vision ML pipelines for video feeds and images (face/object detection, matching, analytics, quality checks, etc.).
  • Develop search and e commerce features using LLMs and retrieval (Apache Solr, Elasticsearch, vector search) and connect them to front end apps and back office tools.
  • Create WhatsApp and multi channel automations powered by LLMs and other AI models.
  • Monitor, debug, and improve AI workflows and integrations running in production environments.
Required Skills
  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial In telligence, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Hands on experience in building and deploying machine learning or LLM based features in real applications (internships, projects, or production experience).
  • Strong programming skills in P ython and experience with deep learning and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, plus common data science libraries (NumPy, pandas, scikit learn, etc.).
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and integrating third party systems (CRM / ERP / Inventory / WhatsApp / etc.).
  • Hands on experience building automations with tools like n8n, Make, or similar low/no code workflow platforms.
  • Comfort deploying models and services (Docker, cloud, simple MLOps) and wiring them into existing products.
  • Solid understanding of natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning techniques, including working with LLMs and transformer-based architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) for building real applications and workflows.
  • Knowledge of data engineering concepts: data preprocessing, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality, and working with relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Familiarity with retrieval and search technologies (e.g., Apache Solr, Elasticsearch, vector search / vector databases) is a strong plus.
  • Exposure to Vision ML (image/video processing, classical CV and/or deep learning based CV) is a plus; strong interest here is also valued.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying ML models or data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Strong research mindset, problem solving skills, and ability to design experiments, interpret results, and iterate.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, comfortable working in cross functional product and client teams.
Nice-to-have / Bonus
  • Experience building AI features specifically for e commerce (search, recommendation, personalization, chatbot, fraud/risk scoring, review analysis) or SaaS products (copilots, analytics insights, smart workflows).
  • Experience with MLOps tools and practices (model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, observability).
  • Prior work in a consulting, services, or staff augmentation context, managing multiple projects or stakeholders.
  • Please include 2 3 concrete examples (links or brief descriptions) of AI/LLM or automation projects you have built or contributed to (e.g., GitHub repos, demos, case studies, Kaggle, hackathons).

Job Description | Content Writer Intern


Location: Bangalore Work From Office (Sarjapur Road)

Type: Full-Time Internship 6 Months

Working Days: Monday Friday | 5 Days/Week

About the Role

We are looking for a Content Writer Intern who is passionate about writing, research, and digital content.

The candidate will work on content related to real estate, PropTech, SaaS, home services, technology, and digital marketing. You will create informative and engaging content for websites, blogs, landing pages, social media, and other digital platforms.

  • Research and write high-quality, informative, and engaging content around real estate, PropTech, SaaS, technology, home services, and related topics.
  • Create blogs, website content, landing page content, articles, guides, and marketing content.
  • Research industry trends, customer questions, competitors, and relevant topics to identify content opportunities.

  • Develop engaging headlines, introductions, CTAs, and content formats for different audiences.
  • Work with the SEO and Marketing teams to create content aligned with search intent and business objectives.

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc. for research, ideation, and content improvement while maintaining originality and quality.
  • Repurpose existing content into different formats such as social posts, short-form content, FAQs, and website copy.
  • Stay updated with developments in real estate, SaaS, technology, AI, and digital marketing.

Requirements

  • Strong English writing and communication skills.
  • Excellent research and information-gathering ability.
  • Ability to write clear, engaging, and well-structured content.
  • Basic understanding of SEO and digital content is preferred.
  • Good understanding of grammar, sentence structure, and proofreading.
  • Interest in Real Estate, PropTech, SaaS, Technology, AI, or Digital Marketing.
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini, Grammarly, or other AI/writing tools is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Candidates must not be currently pursuing studies and should be available for a full-time internship.
  • Willingness to work from office, Monday to Friday.

title: Business System Analyst - Jira Admin
jobDescription:
About HealthEdge

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale and Atlassian is at the center of how work gets done across the organization.

Role Overview

The Atlassian Administrator is a hands-on platform administration role responsible for the day-to-day configuration, maintenance, and user support of HealthEdge's Atlassian environment, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. Working within the Atlassian Products team and reporting to the Manager, Atlassian Products, you will be a key execution resource for platform requests, project configuration, user management, and basic automation – ensuring that thousands of users across the organization can work effectively in Atlassian tools every day.

This is a great role for someone with solid Atlassian fundamentals who wants to deepen their platform expertise in a complex, high-scale environment. You'll work closely with Senior Atlassian Administrators, Architects, and the team manager, taking on well-defined configuration tasks and growing toward more advanced solution design and automation work over time. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, this role will grow to include working with AI-native features like Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo — making content governance and platform hygiene directly connected to AI quality.

What You'll Do

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Administer Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence in a cloud environment
  • Create and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, permission schemes, notification schemes, and screens under the guidance of senior team members
  • Configure and manage JSM service desk projects including request types, queues, SLA configurations, and portal settings
  • Manage Confluence spaces, page permissions, templates, and basic macros to support team knowledge management
  • Perform user and group management including account creation, license assignments, group membership, and access reviews
  • Process and fulfill Atlassian support requests from end users, maintaining SLA compliance in the team's JSM queue

Automation & Reporting

  • Build and maintain native Jira and JSM automation rules for common workflows – ticket routing, notifications, field updates, and status transitions
  • Create and maintain dashboards, saved filters, and basic reports to support team and stakeholder visibility
  • Assist with Confluence automation and page template maintenance
  • Support testing and rollout of automation changes developed by Senior Administrators

User Support & Enablement

  • Serve as a first point of contact for Atlassian support requests, resolving common configuration and usage questions
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues to Senior Atlassian Administrators with clear documentation and context
  • Assist in onboarding new users and teams to Atlassian tools, including basic training and guidance on project setup
  • Contribute to and maintain Atlassian knowledge base articles and how-to documentation for end users

Governance & Housekeeping

  • Perform routine platform hygiene tasks including inactive user cleanup, stale project reviews, and unused field or scheme audits
  • Assist with license usage tracking and reporting to support renewal planning
  • Follow and help enforce Atlassian governance standards for project naming, permissions, and configuration consistency
  • Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access and configuration

Project & Team Support

  • Assist Senior Administrators and the team manager with larger configuration projects, migrations, and platform improvement initiatives
  • Participate in testing and validation of Atlassian upgrades, app changes, and configuration rollouts
  • Document changes accurately in accordance with team change management practices

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Jira and/or Confluence administration experience in a corporate environment
  • Working knowledge of Jira Software project types, workflows, permission schemes, and issue configuration
  • Experience configuring and supporting Jira Service Management (JSM) service desk projects
  • Familiarity with Confluence space administration, page permissions, and content organization
  • Experience with native Jira automation rules
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills – platform hygiene and accuracy matter in this role
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively

Preferred

  • Experience with Atlassian Cloud (vs. Data Center/Server only)
  • Atlassian certification (ACP-120 Jira Administration or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with Atlassian Marketplace apps (ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Atlassian Intelligence or Rovo
  • Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
  • Basic scripting or REST API exposure (not required, but a strong differentiator)
  • Experience working in a global, multi-time zone organization

What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days, you are independently handling the majority of day-to-day Atlassian support requests, have a solid working knowledge of HealthEdge's project and space structure, and are contributing to platform hygiene initiatives. Within six months, you are building and maintaining automation rules confidently, your queue work is consistently within SLA, and stakeholders are getting reliable, well-configured solutions from you. Within a year, you have grown your platform depth meaningfully, are contributing to larger configuration projects, and are beginning to take on more complex solution design work with senior team support.

About the Team

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team within Business Technology, focused on making Jira, JSM, and Confluence work well for thousands of users across a complex global organization. The team values platform rigor, clean governance, and user-focused solutions – and invests in growing the skills of everyone on it. This role is an excellent entry point into a team where strong administrators can grow into senior and lead positions over time.

About the Role

We’re building a nationwide chain of AI & Robotics Skilling Centers and Makers Labs across India, built on a “Skilling to Incubating” model that takes learners from structured training into hands-on prototyping and, eventually, incubation. We’re looking for a Trainer to deliver this curriculum on the ground, teaching core concepts, hand-holding learners through mentored Makers Lab projects, and helping them build real, demonstrable skill rather than passive lecture notes. You’ll work closely with the Practice Head, who sets the curriculum and delivery standards you’ll bring to life in the classroom and lab.


Core Responsibilities Training Delivery

  • Deliver classroom, hybrid, and mentored Makers Lab sessions across assigned capability areas, which may include Edge AI Applications, Computer Vision, Multi-modal AI, Agentic AI, Cloud-based AI, Gen AI & LLMs, or Robotics, as per the curriculum defined by the Practice Head.
  • Hand-hold learners through mentored, hands-on projects rather than deliver lecture-only content, helping candidates move from concept to working prototype.
  • Adapt teaching pace and depth to a mixed pool of learners, ensuring learners with different starting points all reach the required competency bar.
  • Track learner progress, flag gaps early, and provide the extra support or remediation needed to keep learners on pace.

Curriculum Execution & Feedback

  • Deliver the curriculum, tooling, and project briefs as designed, while flagging outdated content, unclear briefs, or gaps observed during delivery back to the Practice Head.
  • Contribute ground-level inputs to keep course content and project briefs current.
  • Maintain session plans, learner assessments, and project documentation to the quality standards set for the network.

Center & Lab Operations

  • Maintain lab and classroom delivery quality in line with the standards set and audited by the Practice Head, so learner experience stays consistent across centers.
  • Use and help maintain GPU-based lab infrastructure and other technical setups needed for sessions.

title: Executive Assistant To CEO (UK- Property Management)
jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to Managing Director - Operations & Project

Coordination


Location: Remote India

Type: Full-time
Salary: 50000 to 65000 per month ( for outstanding candidates can be higher than this )
Progression: Significant opportunity to develop into broader operational responsibilities as the group continues to grow


About the Company : We are a UK-based group of companies operating across:


  • Residential architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Residential property management

Over the last few years, the group has grown to a team of more than 25 people, with most of our operational team working remotely from India.We place a strong emphasis on:


  • Clear systems and processes
  • Accountability
  • Operational efficiency
  • Automation
  • AI
  • Modern technology
  • Taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing individual actions
  • Our team uses platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Trello, TeamGantt, Fireflies, Microsoft 365 and other integrated business systems.

As the group continues to grow, we are looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with the Managing Director and take responsibility for a wide range of administrative, operational and coordination tasks.


The Role


This is not simply a diary-management Executive Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become the Managing Director's highly capable right hand. The role combines:


  • Executive assistance
  • Business administration
  • Task ownership
  • Basic project coordination
  • Follow-up and accountability
  • AI-assisted work
  • Basic property portfolio management
  • General operational support

A major part of your job will be taking tasks away from the Managing Director and making sure they actually get completed.


You may need to coordinate several other employees in order to achieve this.For example, you may be given an objective that requires input from accounts, IT and another department.


Your responsibility is not simply to send everyone an email.Your responsibility is to coordinate the actions, follow up where necessary, identify problems and ensure the required outcome is achieved.


We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

I sent the reminder. and The task was completed.That distinction is extremely important to us.


1. Executive Support: You will help manage the Managing Director's day-to-day business workload. This may include:


  • Managing and organizing the calendar
  • Arranging meetings
  • Preparing information before meetings
  • Following up actions after meetings
  • Drafting emails and correspondence
  • Organising documents and information
  • Researching issues
  • Keeping track of commitments
  • Managing reminders and deadlines
  • Making appointments
  • Obtaining information from other employees
  • Dealing with routine matters without unnecessary escalation
  • Filtering administrative issues before they reach the Managing Director

The objective is to reduce the number of routine matters requiring Managing Director involvement.Where something can reasonably be handled by you, we expect you to take ownership of it.


2. Task Ownership and Follow-ThroughThis is one of the most important parts of the position.The Managing Director will regularly give you tasks or outcomes to achieve.Sometimes these will have clearly defined steps.Other times you may simply be told:Can you sort this out?You should be capable of:


  • Understanding what the required outcome is
  • Working out what needs to happen
  • Identifying who needs to be involved
  • Allocating or requesting actions from colleagues
  • Setting or confirming deadlines
  • Following up outstanding work
  • Checking that information has been received
  • Resolving straightforward problems
  • Identifying when something is going off track
  • Escalating genuinely important issues
  • Confirming that the final outcome has actually been achieved

We do not want someone who considers their responsibility complete simply because they have sent an email or reminder.We want someone who takes responsibility for getting the task over the finish line.


3. Project and Team CoordinationThe role includes basic project coordination.You do not need to be a professionally trained Project Manager and we are not looking for someone focused on complex project-management methodology.However, you should be comfortable coordinating tasks between several people.For example, the Managing Director may decide that the company needs to introduce a new process.You may then need to:


  • Identify the actions required
  • Work out which employees need to be involved
  • Create a simple action plan
  • Coordinate different team members
  • Keep track of deadlines
  • Follow up outstanding tasks
  • Identify delays
  • Make sure dependencies are dealt with
  • Keep the Managing Director informed where necessary
  • Confirm that the new process has actually been implemented

You should be capable of taking something from: Objective Actions Owners Follow-Up Completion Previous experience with project coordination would therefore be useful.


4. AI and Technology Strong practical AI skills are a core requirement for this role. We believe that a modern Executive Assistant should be capable of using AI to dramatically improve their productivity. You should already use, or be highly comfortable using, tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in your normal working life. You may use AI to help with:


  • Research
  • Drafting emails
  • Summarizing meetings
  • Analyzing transcripts
  • Organizing information
  • Comparing documents
  • Preparing reports
  • Creating checklists
  • Drafting procedures
  • Structuring unclear information
  • Researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Preparing meeting notes
  • Solving administrative problems
  • Improving existing processes

You do not need to be a programmer or AI engineer. However, candidates who have little practical experience with AI and little interest in becoming highly proficient with it are unlikely to be suitable. Equally, we do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. You must be capable of:


  • Giving AI clear instructions
  • Providing appropriate context
  • Reviewing outputs critically
  • Spotting mistakes
  • Improving the result
  • Using your own judgement

AI should make you more capable it should not replace your judgement.


5. Basic Property Portfolio Management: One of the companies within the group, CEB Properties, operates a very small UK residential property portfolio of approximately six properties.Part of your role will involve handling its routine day-to-day administration.


This is not a specialist property-management position, and the portfolio is deliberately small.


The company is building clear operating systems, workflows, checklists and procedures to make these tasks straightforward to manage.

Typical responsibilities may include:


  • Responding to routine tenant communication
  • Coordinating property viewings
  • Arranging maintenance
  • Contacting contractors
  • Following up repairs
  • Coordinating check-ins and check-outs
  • Organising referencing
  • Managing routine tenancy administration
  • Keeping property records organised
  • Monitoring safety and compliance deadlines
  • Arranging periodic inspections
  • Making sure routine property tasks are completed

Previous property-management or real-estate experience would be an advantage because you will already understand some of these processes. However, it is not essential


A capable and organized person should be able to learn this part of the role quickly using the systems provided.


6. Business Administration : You will take responsibility for a variety of routine business-administration tasks across the group.This may include:

  • Insurance renewals
  • Insurance claims administration
  • Obtaining quotations
  • Managing subscriptions
  • Supplier accounts
  • Routine business registrations
  • Organising company records
  • Renewing services
  • Basic purchasing
  • Booking appointments
  • Researching suppliers or services
  • Filling in forms
  • Following up third parties
  • Organising documents
  • Maintaining records
  • Updating trackers
  • Managing routine correspondence
  • Checking that recurring administrative tasks have been completed

We need someone who does not consider ordinary administrative work beneath them. At the same time, we want you to continually look for ways to make repetitive work easier.


You should naturally ask:


Can this be simplified?

Can AI help with this?

Can this be automated?

Can we create a template?

Can we create a checklist so we don't have to rethink this next time?


7. Follow-Up and Accountability Across the Team: Because we have a team of more than 20 people, the Managing Director cannot personally follow up every outstanding action. You will help create accountability. his may involve:


  • Following up department heads
  • Following up individual team members

title: Lead Applied AI / LLM Engineer
jobDescription:
Lead Applied AI / LLM Engineer

PERMANENT FULL-TIME OPPORTUNITY


RAG, Agents & Evaluation | Remote-first within India | Reports to the CTO


Experience: 37 years
Joining: ASAP; within 30 days preferred
Fixed salary: INR 24,00,00028,00,000 p.a.
Variable: Up to INR 3,00,000 p.a.
Location: Anywhere in India; Gurugram/NCR attendance as required
Work model: Flexible hours; core overlap 11:00 AM4:00 PM IST




The mandate:



AKS is building a permanent technical core of engineers who own outcomes, not isolated tickets. You will take end-to-end responsibility for applied AI systems across discovery, architecture, implementation, evaluation, deployment, UAT, production support, documentation and handover. You will coordinate directly with the CTO, collaborate with the full-stack lead and, where appropriate, guide interns or junior engineers while retaining accountability for the final result.


This is primarily an applied LLM and application-engineering role. Model training and research are part of the toolkit, but the central objective is to deliver reliable systems that work with real client data, constraints and acceptance criteria. A typical portfolio may include one or two active PoC/UAT builds and several systems in hypercare or maintenance.



What makes this role different:


AI coding agents and approved model/tool subscriptions are provided and encouraged. You remain accountable for architecture, correctness, security, tests and every accepted change. You must understand and be able to defend the system without relying on the tool that generated a suggestion.


What you will own

  • Convert ambiguous business and client problems into written technical outcomes, acceptance criteria and delivery plans.
  • Design, build and maintain production-oriented RAG, agentic and document-intelligence systems with explicit boundaries between deterministic logic, conventional ML and generative components.
  • Own ingestion, retrieval, embeddings, vector search, prompting, structured outputs, tool use, orchestration, guardrails and human-review paths.
  • Build defensible evaluations for retrieval quality, groundedness, citations, entity isolation, refusal behaviour, latency, cost and failure cases; turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Fine-tune models using LoRA or related parameter-efficient methods and deploy reproducible inference-serving workflows.
  • Develop production-quality Python services and APIs; integrate AI components with FastAPI applications, PostgreSQL/vector stores and frontend or workflow systems.
  • Deploy and troubleshoot services on cloud and client-controlled Linux/GPU environments using Docker, CI/CD, logging and monitoring.
  • Reuse proven components across applications without creating hidden coupling; improve existing repositories rather than rebuilding everything by default.
  • Maintain clear Git history, pull requests, tests, runbooks, architecture decisions, model/evaluation records and knowledge-transfer material.
  • Communicate progress, dependencies, risks and production incidents clearly to the CTO, delivery stakeholders and clients where required.
  • Review work and nurture interns or junior engineers when assigned; ownership cannot be delegated away.


Required capabilities

  • 3–7 years of relevant software, ML or applied-AI experience, including personally shipped systems.
  • Strong Python engineering and hands-on PyTorch proficiency.
  • Strong foundations in statistics, statistical machine learning, deep learning, experimental design and practical model evaluation.
  • Production experience with LLM applications, RAG or agentic workflows; ability to diagnose retrieval, grounding, hallucination, identity and tool-use failures.
  • Hands-on LoRA fine-tuning and inference serving, including data preparation, baselines, leakage control, versioning, evaluation, capacity and rollback considerations.
  • Working knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, information retrieval, structured extraction and document-processing pipelines.
  • Strong Git and GitHub proficiency: branches, pull requests, reviewable commits, code review and repository hygiene.
  • Strong Linux, Docker, REST API, testing and debugging skills; working knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring and at least one cloud platform.
  • Ability to reason about security, privacy, client-data boundaries, model/provider selection, cost, latency and production fallback behaviour.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; direct client discovery or review experience is highly valued.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant quantitative discipline.


Preferred experience

  • Quantization, GPU-memory/performance optimization, vLLM or comparable model-serving frameworks.
  • PostgreSQL with pgvector or other vector stores; Pydantic/FastAPI; evaluation and observability tooling such as MLflow, Langfuse, Phoenix or OpenTelemetry.
  • Enterprise document intelligence, legal/research assistants, RFQ/quotation automation, voice/calling automation or other high-trust workflows.
  • Local/on-premise model deployment, distributed inference, Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code.
  • Conventional ML problems such as classification, forecasting or ranking where labels, calibration and business-valid metrics matter.
  • Informal technical leadership, code review and guidance of interns/junior engineers.


Success in the first 90 days

  • Establish a verified architecture, data-flow, evaluation and deployment map for the assigned portfolio.
  • Reproduce existing baselines and known failures; resolve at least one bounded maintenance issue through a reviewed deployment.
  • Put representative evaluation/regression checks into the delivery workflow and ship one measurable reliability improvement.
  • Demonstrate a reproducible LoRA training and serving workflow in staging.
  • Lead one active PoC/UAT workstream while maintaining transparent status and risk control across 4–5 systems.
  • Deliver or materially advance one system to a written acceptance milestone and leave reusable, documented components behind.

Work model and support expectations

  • Permanent, full-time and remote-first within India. Attendance at the Gurugram office or client meetings may be required with reasonable notice.
  • Eight working hours on each scheduled workday, excluding breaks. The normal reference window is 9:30 AM–6:30 PM IST with a one-hour meal break; start/end times may flex while preserving mandatory availability from 11:00 AM–4:00 PM IST.
  • Regular Monday–Friday schedule plus two pre-notified working Saturdays per calendar month. The Saturday schedule is communicated before the month begins.
  • Routine overnight support is not expected. Exceptional production incidents may occasionally require availability outside normal hours, handled under company policy and applicable requirements.
  • Client travel is currently infrequent and primarily within NCR. Approved business travel outside NCR is reimbursed; other required travel arrangements are confirmed in advance.

Compensation and support

  • Annual fixed gross salary: INR 24,00,000–28,00,000.
  • Performance-linked variable pay: up to INR 3,00,000 per annum, assessed and payable quarterly against written, measurable outcomes. Variable pay is not guaranteed and may be prorated for eligible service.
  • Company-funded access to approved coding agents, model APIs and role-relevant software subscriptions.
  • Approved learning resources or certifications may be company-funded where relevant to delivery.
  • A company laptop/workstation may be provided based on role and information-security requirements.
  • Paid leave, holidays and statutory benefits in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

Selection process

  1. Structured initial evidence and logistics screen with HR.
  2. Technical architecture and ownership interview with the CTO.
  3. Role-relevant synthetic work sample; approved coding agents may be used with disclosure and verification.
  4. Final alignment and, where appropriate, consent-based reference or document verification.


Equal opportunity and accommodation

AKS Intelligent Systems LLP evaluates applicants on job-related capabilities and experience. Qualified candidates may request reasonable accommodation during the selection process. Please do not send Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or other sensitive identity documents with the initial application.


This job description summarizes the present role and is not an employment contract. Responsibilities may evolve with client and company priorities. Final terms are stated in the written offer and appointment documents.

jobDescription:
Fisheries Research Analyst AI & Computer Vision
Colour grading of the species for quantifying freshness


Location: India / Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 5-8 Years
Domain: Fisheries | Aquaculture | Marine & Inland Fisheries
Open to Travel: Yes, as required


About the Role

Wisewit Solutions is looking for a Fisheries Research Analyst AI & Computer Vision to bridge the gap between fisheries domain expertise and AI technology.

The role will involve researching fisheries and aquaculture processes, understanding real-world field challenges, collecting and validating domain data, and working closely with AI/ML and Computer Vision teams to develop practical technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of fish/aquaculture species, farming, seafood processing plants, production lines, exports, and fisheries terminology, along with an interest in AI, data and emerging technologies.


Key Responsibilities

Fisheries Domain Research

  • Research Indian marine, inland fisheries and aquaculture practices.
  • Study fish and shrimp species, production processes, farming practices and harvesting operations.
  • Understand fish health, disease indicators, feed, water quality and environmental parameters.
  • Research fisheries value chains, landing centres, farms, processing units and field operations.
  • Identify operational challenges that can potentially be addressed using AI and automation.

AI & Computer Vision Research

  • You will work with AI/ML and Computer Vision teams to translate fisheries requirements into technical inputs.
  • Identify suitable use cases for image-based identification, classification, detection and monitoring.
  • Help define fish/species categories, attributes, visual characteristics and domain-specific classifications.
  • Assist in developing guidelines for image and video data collection.
  • Review and validate AI-generated outputs from a fisheries-domain perspective.
  • Identify false positives, false negatives and domain-specific errors in AI models.
  • Support creation and validation of datasets for Computer Vision and Machine Learning projects.

Data & Dataset Development

  • Collect fisheries-related data from research papers, government sources, field studies and industry sources.
  • Organise and clean structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Support image/video dataset creation and annotation activities.
  • Develop domain-specific taxonomies, labels, metadata and reference datasets.
  • Verify the accuracy and consistency of annotated data.
  • Maintain documentation and version-controlled research references.

Field Research & Validation

  • Conduct field visits to farms, hatcheries, fishing locations, landing centres and processing facilities.
  • Interact with fishermen, farmers, aquaculture professionals and other domain experts.
  • Document actual field processes and operational challenges.
  • Collect images, videos, observations and other relevant field data.
  • Validate whether AI solutions work effectively under real-world conditions.

Research & Documentation

  • Conduct literature reviews and analyse scientific publications.
  • Track developments in fisheries technology, AI applications and aquaculture.
  • Prepare research reports, use-case documents and domain briefs.
  • Create clear documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Present research findings to AI, engineering and business teams.

AI Use Cases You May Work On

Depending on the project, the role may contribute to areas such as:

  • Fish and shrimp species identification
  • Fish size/length estimation
  • Fish counting and biomass estimation
  • Fish quality assessment
  • Disease or abnormality detection
  • Aquaculture pond monitoring
  • Fish grading and sorting
  • Fish catch classification
  • Image/video-based fisheries monitoring
  • Farm productivity analysis
  • Fisheries supply-chain intelligence
  • Computer Vision-based inspection systems

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Fisheries Science, Aquaculture, Marine Biology, Zoology, Aquatic Sciences or a related field.
  • 15 years of experience in fisheries, aquaculture, fisheries research, field research or a related domain.
  • Strong understanding of Indian fisheries/aquaculture practices.
  • Good research, analytical and documentation skills.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
  • Ability to interpret scientific papers, research reports and technical information.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work with multidisciplinary teams.

Good to Have

  • Exposure to AI/ML, Computer Vision or Data Science.
  • Experience with image/video data collection or annotation.
  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, Power BI or similar analytical tools.
  • Familiarity with GIS/geospatial data.
  • Experience working with fisheries datasets.
  • Knowledge of fish/shrimp species identification.
  • Experience conducting field surveys or stakeholder interviews.
  • Understanding of AI model evaluation or dataset validation.

Who Would Be a Good Fit?

We are looking for someone who can say:

I understand fisheries, I understand the problem in the field, and I can explain that problem clearly enough for an AI/engineering team to build a solution.”

You don’t need to be an AI engineer. However, you should be curious about AI and comfortable working closely with technical teams.


Key Skills

Fisheries Domain | Aquaculture | Research | Data Analysis | Field Research | Dataset Validation | Computer Vision | AI Use Cases | Documentation | Stakeholder Interaction


Travel

This role may require travel to aquaculture farms, fishing locations, landing centres, processing facilities, research institutions and client locations across India.

Candidates should be comfortable with travel as required by project requirements.
